title: Failure probability at zero width
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on $n$ sign coordinates whose width is zero, and let $\delta\in\mathbb R$ and $k\in\mathbb N$ with $k>0$. The probability of coordinate-switching failure for $\varphi$ at parameter $\delta$ and threshold $k$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates
